title: Source: src/agent_runtime/guidance
summary: File ownership, boundaries, state and collaborators.
html:
Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/guidance

src/agent_runtime/guidance/init.py

Python · Tier A

Expose request_scope and select for source-owned instruction selection. Compact settings and Prompt Editor overrides are captured together; without either, selection preserves the original object. The package never derives instructions from user messages or tool evidence.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/bindings.py

Python · Tier A

Carry explicit instruction provenance beside result/history bytes. Producers record JSON paths, exact digests and spans; projection verifies those bindings and copies only changed ancestors, preserving unfamiliar history and returned evidence.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
BoundResult 16 A normal JSON result with out-of-band producer metadata until journal append.
binding 30 Record an explicit JSON path, exact whole-leaf digest and one owned source span. Optional restore text reconstructs a canonical source before selection; span bounds are validated when projecting, not when recording.
at 47 Follow a producer-supplied mapping/list path and return None for missing or incompatible traversal, allowing projection to leave unfamiliar history untouched.
project 60 Group spans by leaf path/digest, verify the entire original leaf and reject overlapping or out- of-bounds spans before accepting that leaf update. Select only verified source spans and apply exact before/after replacements through copy-on-write projection. Unrecognized history stays unchanged and digest mismatches record source IDs without content.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/catalog.py

Python · Tier A

Adapt the sealed prompt database to guidance switches and source bindings. Cached Blocks carry reviewed fingerprints, composite offsets and variant metadata; sorted settings entries and a content revision support the UI and request caches.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
fingerprint 15 Hash exact UTF-8 source bytes so whitespace or wording drift prevents a variant from being applied to an unrelated instruction.
Block 23 Describe a release-owned instruction variant and its review metadata. Composite spans identify constituent source IDs and offsets; digests bind them to exact original text rather than to assembled user prompts.
blocks 50 Cache the guidance view of the sealed prompt database, normalizing sequence metadata to tuples. Reject unknown UI layers and empty compact text; release-asset validation occurs in prompts.catalog before these records are exposed.
catalogue 70 Build deterministically ordered settings entries with labels, ownership and availability metadata. Prompt bodies are inspected through Prompt Editor rather than embedded in this switch inventory.
feedback_sources 90 Exact, source-owned compositions; each constituent keeps its own switch.
revision 101 Cache a digest of source/variant versions, composite bindings and feedback sources for cache invalidation. This identifies release guidance contents, independently of user override revisions.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/composites.py

Python · Tier A

Split only reviewed instruction composites into independently selectable sources. Whole-source fingerprints protect authored offsets; render serves current outbound text and bindings records equivalent metadata for later history projection.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
pieces 13 Return registered constituent spans only when the entire composite matches its reviewed digest. Changed composites produce a fallback diagnostic and no spans; a non-composite uses the whole original as one source.
render 25 Select each source span in an active, exact known composite and join the results. Return the original unchanged when projection is inactive or source validation fails.
bindings 38 Convert known composite offsets into persisted producer metadata for a specific result path. Each binding carries the whole original leaf digest so later history projection can verify it.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/feedback.py

Python · Tier A

Project instructions owned by runtime feedback and concrete receipt adapters. Exact digest/span bindings restrict selection to known guidance fields; arbitrary tool data stays opaque, saved history stays canonical and internal metadata is stripped from outbound messages.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
sources 42 Cache exact source digests for Recovery blocks and owned collaboration/completion instructions, then merge explicitly authored feedback compositions. These mappings authorize instruction spans, not arbitrary tool evidence.
source_bindings 54 Resolve an exact original-string digest to one source or an authored composition and emit path/span metadata. Unknown strings yield no bindings and remain opaque.
project 70 Inspect only whitelisted instruction fields and named runtime feedback envelopes, cloning a dictionary only when a verified projection changes a value. Callers must establish ownership before using this helper.
messages 95 Use message-local or tool-call-indexed history bindings to project recognized JSON tool messages. Strip internal binding metadata even with compact mode off; keep malformed content, non-tool messages and unrecognized historical text unchanged apart from that internal field.
capture 129 Collect exact source bindings from the runtime-owned instruction whitelist and nested owned envelopes, preserving paths without searching ordinary tool data.
receipt_bindings 145 Add bindings for the concrete schedule, email and web-search fields owned by those adapters, and recurse through runtime aggregate steps/items. Arbitrary returned data remains outside the search boundary.
fields 185 Extend the instruction whitelist only for runtime-stamped no-new-information/fresh-observation messages or completion-status errors. Ordinary message/error fields are not presumed to contain instructions.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/manifest.py

Python · Tier A

Retain the explicit compatibility-module inventory for source navigation. The active catalog reads prompts.catalog.guidance_blocks from the sealed database; this tuple does not import or register runtime wording. Each named guidance_compact module exposes its compiled owner view.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/policy.py

Python · Tier A

Validate compact-guidance preferences and publish immutable request policies. GuidanceOwner retains the last accepted settings, diagnoses invalid startup input and supplies snapshots to selection.py; prompt wording and editor override persistence belong to prompts/.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
CompactGuidanceSettings 16 Validate the saved master switch and per-block choices without accepting extra fields or coercing types. Version 1 and registered source IDs are required; validation is shared by startup recovery and settings publication.
CompactGuidanceSettings.integer_version 27 Reject booleans, strings and unsupported integers before Literal validation so the persisted version has an exact integer contract.
CompactGuidanceSettings.registered_blocks 36 Validate every explicitly saved switch against the compiled release catalog. Unknown IDs raise; omitted IDs retain the enabled master switch as their default.
Snapshot 48 Carry immutable compact-mode choices and a local publication revision into one logical request. The derived disabled-ID set makes selection independent of later settings writes; this object does not contain Prompt Editor overrides.
Snapshot.selected 63 Return whether this snapshot selects compact wording for an ID. Registration and source matching are checked by other layers, not this membership test.
Snapshot.as_dict 68 Export only the versioned settings payload, omitting the in-process revision and derived disabled set.
GuidanceOwner 78 Publish settings atomically under a lock while readers retain immutable snapshots. Invalid saved input starts with full guidance and an error diagnostic; invalid later publication raises without replacing the current snapshot.
GuidanceOwner.snapshot 95 Return the currently published immutable object without copying settings or opening persistent storage.
GuidanceOwner.publish 101 Validate before locking, sort explicit block choices and increase the local revision only when settings change. Publish one replacement snapshot, clear the saved-settings diagnostic and return the accepted snapshot.
resolve_owner 112 Follow runtime/client wrappers without process-global mutable defaults.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/projection.py

Python · Tier A

Apply exact path-and-original-text replacements to detached outgoing structures. changes records differing string leaves from paired producer outputs; apply copies only changed containers, leaving stored objects and unrelated values intact.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
changes 7 Build exact field bindings from the same pure producer and factual inputs.
apply 28 Copy only changed ancestors. Exact path AND original text must match. Bindings come from explicit application instruction producers, never searches of arbitrary messages. No traversal into unrelated evidence or user content.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/protocol.py

Python · Tier A

Project the canonical system protocol while retaining independently owned sudo, status, efficiency and Task Context instructions. Exact full-protocol recognition protects custom and historical text; this module does not change protocol facts or tool schemas.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
project 23 Recognize only the canonical legacy or Task Context system protocol, partition its known embedded sudo/status/efficiency sections and select each block independently. Preserve custom/historical prefixes and missing-marker cases verbatim; retain the original efficiency newline and notebook environment substitution rules.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/selection.py

Python · Tier A

Bind compact choices and Prompt Editor overrides to a logical model request. Source selection checks exact release fingerprints, records bounded fallback reasons and supplies cache identities; canonical-history scopes suppress outgoing projection.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
Binding 16 Hold a request-pinned compact policy, optional Prompt Editor snapshot and bounded content-free fallback diagnostics. Context-local ownership separates simultaneous requests.
request_scope 32 Capture both settings and prompt overrides before request assembly. Nested scopes reuse the parent unless fresh=True; a fresh scope resolves the supplied runtime/client owner. On exit report fallback IDs/reasons to logging and the active latency timeline, then restore the previous context.
selected 61 Consult only the current request binding for the compact switch; an unbound caller remains off.
originals 67 Keep canonical snapshots/journal writes full, even inside request construction.
active 80 Report whether outgoing projection is needed for compact selection or saved Prompt Editor overrides. Full-wording overrides remain active while the compact master switch is off.
select 90 Resolve one explicitly identified canonical source against its release fingerprint. With neither compact selection nor overrides, return the original object immediately. Otherwise retain changed/missing sources with a diagnostic, or resolve the selected full/compact variant from the pinned override snapshot. The legacy docstring below predates Prompt Editor: turning compact off still permits a saved full-wording override.
fallback 112 Add an ID/reason pair to the current request diagnostics, up to 128 distinct entries; never retain prompt bodies or user parameters.
identity 120 Return the active compact choices, compiled catalog revision and override revision for request/fragment cache keys. An inactive or unbound request uses the empty identity.

src/agent_runtime/guidance/tools.py

Python · Tier A

Select outgoing tool-description wording on caller-detached declarations. ToolCatalog supplies canonical capability identities; wait controls retain their separately selectable ordering suffix. Shared registry metadata must be copied before calling.

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
project_descriptions 16 Mutate description strings on the detached tool declarations supplied by the caller and return the same list. Select the exact wait-order suffix separately from its control description; other descriptions use reviewed composite spans. This helper does not clone shared catalog declarations and must not receive them directly.
